subject.title: feat(diagnostics-otel): identify each instance with service.instance.id

question: Should diagnostics-otel accept a new `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID` plus hostname fallback contract, or should `service.instance.id` come from standard `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES` or an approved OpenClaw stable identity seam?
rationale: The choice affects operator-facing env/config precedence, telemetry grouping, uniqueness guarantees, and default host-identity exposure, and the canonical issue already marks this as a maintainer identity-design decision.

options.title: Align with canonical identity issue
options.body: Remove the custom env/hostname contract and implement instance identity through the standard OTel resource path or an approved OpenClaw-owned stable identity seam.

options.title: Adopt the new env contract
options.body: Accept `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID`, but require explicit docs, precedence rules, privacy guidance, and upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Pause this PR
options.body: Keep this PR blocked or close it if maintainers want the canonical identity issue to land the complete design instead.

recommendation.title: Align with canonical identity issue
recommendation.body: Remove the custom env/hostname contract and implement instance identity through the standard OTel resource path or an approved OpenClaw-owned stable identity seam.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc has the strongest recent diagnostics-otel runtime and config-surface history among the identified owners.
